text:
A new quarter starts **Monday**, and so do the SHINE presentations.

Your Chemistry test is the week after this one. The date is not fixed yet, so plan for early in that week. A little at a time beats a lot the night before: a Chemistry round on **Wednesday** and another on **Thursday** is a good start.

**Friday** is Odd Socks Day, so pick out two socks that do not match on Thursday night. And there is a new door on this screen: your Wonder Jar, for one happy thought a night.
